svg.title: The public boundary of DorkOS Cloud
svg.desc: Optional local Cloud clients use HTTPS. Legacy app-side paths coexist with the versioned public contract. A runtime may use a separately returned inference endpoint when explicitly enabled. The existing tunnel is a separate route to the local server.
